facts: Base URL is https://api.ads.openai.com/v1.
Requests use Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY.
Each Ads API key is scoped to one ad account.
The documented bearer-token check is GET /ad_account.
sources.account_prerequisite: Existing Ads API key for the intended account

facts: GET /ad_account has no request body or query parameters.
Its documented response includes account identity metadata, status where available, timezone, currency code, and review status.
sources.account_prerequisite: Configured account-scoped key reference, resolved target account, and private response handling within the authorized acceptance read scope

facts: Delivery reads are GET /ad_account/insights, GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/insights, GET /ad_groups/{ad_group_id}/insights, and GET /ads/{ad_id}/insights.
Attributed conversion totals use POST /conversions/insights.
Conversions equals click_through_conversions; view_through_conversions is separate supplemental reporting.
sources.account_prerequisite: Configured account-scoped key reference, resolved target account, exact object references and time window, and private response handling within the authorized acceptance read scope

facts: Pixel ID is required and is created in the conversions tab of Ads Manager.
Debug logs SDK activity to the browser console.
Consent false prevents event pings and blocked events are not replayed.
sources.account_prerequisite: Existing Pixel ID, consent-compliant site deployment, and deployment approval

facts: CAPI is server-to-server and accepts validate_only=true to validate without saving events.
Batches are limited to 1,000 events and one invalid event fails the full batch.
CAPI keys and Pixel IDs are provisioned in Ads Manager, or by approved API partners through conversion setup.
sources.account_prerequisite: Existing Pixel ID and server-held CAPI key, plus separately approved test-event transmission

facts: GET /conversions/events returns up to 50 Pixel SDK events from the previous 15 minutes and is a receipt diagnostic, not attribution reporting.
The stream is enabled-account-only; documented 404 remediation is partner contact.
If Pixel and CAPI send the same event, they need a shared event ID for deduplication.
Pixel management and CAPI-key creation are account-enabled capabilities.
sources.account_prerequisite: Configured account-scoped key reference, resolved target account, existing Pixel ID for the event stream, and separately approved mutation scope for resource-creation endpoints

locators: How do I validate that the JavaScript Pixel is installed correctly?
facts: Ads Manager documents separate cumulative and daily CSV exports, optional VTA when available, and event-specific columns selected before export.
The page does not publish a complete native CSV schema.
The page directs Pixel validation through correct initialization and debug mode and says reporting can take 24-48 hours for attributed conversions.
sources.account_prerequisite: Accessible Ads Manager reporting controls and an exportable report

facts: Self-service account creation and self-service availability are separate.
The legal entity that advertises and is billed must be based in a listed country for self-service.
The page was labeled Updated: 4 days ago when retrieved.

local_evidence.fact: Native CSV adapter is disabled pending a real sanitized native CSV and tested source-field contract.
The local analyzer does not detect or ingest native ChatGPT Ads exports.
